title: lichen-gateway: 7 residual red tests after identity-IID slice (4 end_to_end CorrelationMismatch + 2 tunnel_auth wired + 1 resources reject-update)
description: Residuals of r3e5 after 58049f20d8 fixed 6 of 13 (DIS/DIO destination gate + provision_closed_federation now bind the canonical identity IID, not the routable 02xx low half — post-AddrForKey nnmc-class bugs). REMAINING: (1) end_to_end.rs 4 tests, all failing at client.decrypt_response with CorrelationMismatch (secure.rs decrypt_response_to): runtime_ingress_dispatches_authenticated_gcp_slot_claim:1077, runtime_ingress_handoff_commits_after_protected_response:1321, runtime_ingress_handoff_rolls_back_when_sender_state_persistence_fails, gateway_rejects_replayed_authenticated_wire_before_forwarding. Suspect response construction on the conflict/GCP path post-merge. (2) tunnel_auth_vectors.rs: wired_egress_forwards_authorized_tunnel + wired_egress_matches_grant_under_distinct_root_via_own_iid_route_evidence (not yet diagnosed). (3) resources.rs rejected_conflicting_claim_moves_highwater_and_peer_claim_together: test data internally inconsistent — local_address[8..].fill(0x01) makes the local IID always LOWEST, so the first claim hits the we-win conflict arm (4.09) instead of the expected 2.04 accept; fix the test to use a high local IID (0xff) like its siblings or adjust expectations.
